rows.action: Validate all ce55 QDP fields, legacy/additive commands, lifecycle locks, dictionaries, UI references and the PCBA exact-writer boundary.
rows.assertion: All 20 legacy QDP writer fields and legacy release command remain addressable; compile is additive in the same handler, while PCBA remains an exact adapter rather than a public writer.

rows.action: Exercise prepare, compile, validation failure/retry, partial success, review, release, replay, stale, external failure and supersede directly against the existing QDP writer.
rows.assertion: The single Core writer persists async transitions, fails closed on invalid binding and preserves lifecycle, idempotency, concurrency and legacy behavior.

rows.action: Compare the old standalone plugin CLI with the host-supported async command presentation contract.
rows.assertion: Fresh host import, reference integrity and runtime execution pass, but the old standalone CLI does not recognize every current host command-presentation property.

rows.action: Prepare a QDP from qualified PCBA input and bind immutable Requirement Version, retained File Package and Customer Confirmation records.
rows.assertion: Customer Confirmation binds the exact Requirement Version and canonical SHA-256 package hash; missing, stale, cross-target and non-retained inputs fail closed.

rows.action: Drive Draft through compiled review readiness, Released and Superseded while preserving legacy release compatibility.
rows.assertion: Released content is immutable, later release supersedes the prior record by CAS, and legacy commands still use the same public writer.

rows.action: Persist and read diff, Pack Set, downstream impact, assumptions and exception snapshots across compilation and release.
rows.assertion: GT-D04 inputs remain bound to immutable QDP content and render as readable Hash, diff, Pack Set and impact summaries.

rows.action: Dispatch compile through the platform async command/task path and poll its durable progress.
rows.assertion: The QDP and async task expose real Compiling/running stages before completion; the final record becomes Ready for Review without a parallel writer.

rows.action: Invalidate Customer Confirmation, observe durable Validation Failed, correct the binding and retry the same QDP.
rows.assertion: Validation failure persists its stage/message and a corrected retry transitions the same record through Compiling to Ready for Review.

groups.title: Permissions, tenancy, concurrency, replay, audit and external failure

rows.action: Send stale expected versions, repeated identities and changed-intent replays across prepare, compile and release.
rows.assertion: Target and QDP transitions enforce optimistic concurrency, stable replay, lock conflict and changed-intent rejection.

rows.action: Attempt lifecycle/compile commands without permission, across tenants and through direct field writes, then inspect audit records.
rows.assertion: No-permission is 403, cross-tenant access and direct writes are denied, explicit release duty is required, and 44 audit records cover the fresh-host probes.

rows.action: Invalidate a referenced file after draft creation, observe fail-closed release, restore retention and retry.
rows.assertion: External retention failure is explicit and leaves lifecycle recoverable; restored evidence can subsequently release.

rows.action: Open the Release Center list and a released detail in the fresh current-source host.
rows.assertion: Title/code, lifecycle, GT-D04, revision, Hash, diff, Requirement Version, confirmation, Pack Set and downstream impact are localized and readable without raw data leakage.
rows.vision_check: Original 1280x720 screenshots show Released, Complete for Release, revision 4, a 64-character content hash, Changed: Requirement Version, File Package Hash, Pack Set, PCBA-MFG@browser and 1 downstream object(s), 0 blocked; no raw crm_qdp_* code or JSON is visible.

rows.action: Compile from the browser and observe the live async task before completion.
rows.assertion: A progress indicator and in-progress copy are visible while the real async task is running.
rows.vision_check: The original PNG visibly contains the compile/validate in-progress state and progress indicator over the real detail page.

rows.action: Search for a non-existent QDP and wait for the real list request to finish.
rows.assertion: The completed empty query renders an explicit No data state rather than an ambiguous blank table.
rows.vision_check: The original PNG visibly shows the no-match query and the localized empty-state illustration/copy.

rows.action: Compile a valid QDP with an approved exception and inspect task and detail outcomes.
rows.assertion: The async task completes but explicitly labels Partial Success; the persistent detail keeps the approved-exception warning and review-ready lifecycle.
rows.vision_check: Original modal and detail PNGs visibly show the localized partial-success outcome and approved-exception warning without raw outcome codes.

rows.action: Trigger stale release feedback and navigate as a user without QDP access.
rows.assertion: Stale feedback tells the user to prepare a new revision; the denied role sees an explicit access boundary without QDP data or actions.
rows.vision_check: Original screenshots visibly contain the stale corrective error and Page Unavailable/Access denied boundary.
